Name: Bountiful Foraging - Forage Even More Items
Author: CodeKokeshi
Description:
[center][b]DISCLAIMER:[/b] I've only tested this in VANILLA STARDEW so please don't expect everything to work with OVERHAUL MODS :D[b]

Description:[/b]
Make forageables bountiful. All areas spawn forageables every day at multiplied yield. Never have an empty foraging spot again!

_________________________________________________________________________________________________

[b]Disclaimer:[/b]Please report any issues with a detailed description in the comments or bug section. I am a total beginner to Stardew Valley and its modding scene. [b]When I created this mod, my in-game progress was Spring 26, Year 1.[/b]
_______________________________________________

[b]In game screenshots (mod v1.1.0)[/b]

This is not the default value. The default value is fine, toned down and simulates the bountiful foraging. I just want to show you how it will look like at max value.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/00nekxP.png[/img]


More digging spots! Yes you can multiply digging spots now.
﻿
[img]https://i.imgur.com/7R2rEKS.png[/img]﻿

Normal Forage Items Multiplied to Maximum Value.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/i5nLuTM.png[/img]﻿

So after inspecting the game's codebase. I realized that the Sea Uchin, Corals and other Foraged Items are on their own and not a part of Spawnable Objects. Thus they have a separate settings in the GMCM.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WOtb5jw.png[/img]﻿[/center]
